e143minzpcft2.text: I heard him once at a village festival. When you listen to his songs, you laugh, then you cry — you're busy the whole time!

e9y2edx3eyel.speaker: narr

e9y2edx3eyel.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e14a15z35um5w.speaker: kromngoy
e14a15z35um5w.text: ♪ The rice field will not wait for you — a morning slept away won't come back
e14a15z35um5w.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1wwtse9tjspe.speaker: kromngoy
e1wwtse9tjspe.text: ♪ Learn your letters and you'll see the road — never learn, and you'll be fooled
e1wwtse9tjspe.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1xbcbrw8j8b2.speaker: narr

e7vxpi6b1xjm.speaker: nekmax
e7vxpi6b1xjm.text: Krom Ngoy taught through his songs — about work in the fields, and why learning matters. The song you just heard is a simple retelling of what he taught.
e7vxpi6b1xjm.heard: Krom Ngoy taught through his songs—about work in the fields, and why learning matters. The song you just heard is a simple retelling of what he taught.
e7vxpi6b1xjm.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ebqw85jj6sd1.speaker: narr
ebqw85jj6sd1.text: When the song ended, the old man looked your way and grinned.
ebqw85jj6sd1.heard: When the song ended, the old man looked your way and grinned.
ebqw85jj6sd1.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

eithuey1a9dd.speaker: kromngoy
eithuey1a9dd.text: Haven't seen your face before. Come from far away, have you?
eithuey1a9dd.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e13s1ggu2ikqy.speaker: kromngoy

e13s1ggu2ikqy.heard: I'm Krom Ngoy. The name I was born with is Ouk Ou, but everyone calls me Krom Ngoy.

e42kho17cb9q.speaker: kromngoy
e42kho17cb9q.text: Well, well, you came again. My songs must have caught your fancy.
e42kho17cb9q.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ejhrfzaozuf.speaker: kromngoy
e1ejhrfzaozuf.text: Haven't seen your face before. …No, wait — have we met somewhere?
e1ejhrfzaozuf.heard: Haven't seen your face before. …No, wait — have we met somewhere?
e1ejhrfzaozuf.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1p18n9d14zl8.speaker: kromngoy
e1p18n9d14zl8.text: I'm Krom Ngoy. Just a singer of songs.
e1p18n9d14zl8.heard: I'm Krom Ngoy. Just a singer of songs.
e1p18n9d14zl8.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e900bqgci2gp.speaker: borey
e900bqgci2gp.text: I'm Borey! Krom Ngoy, how do you remember all your songs? Are they written on paper?
e900bqgci2gp.heard: Krom Ngoy, how do you remember all your songs? Are they written on paper?
e900bqgci2gp.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

evvxk1ta3a61.speaker: kromngoy
evvxk1ta3a61.text: Ha ha ha. I've never once written a song on paper. They're all kept in here.
evvxk1ta3a61.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ed2erra11m56.speaker: narr
ed2erra11m56.text: The old man thumped his chest with his big hand.
ed2erra11m56.heard: The old man thumped his chest with his big hand.

e1n1yegh1tsg6.text: But you know, I'm sixty-five now. And as a song passes from mouth to mouth, little by little, it changes.
e1n1yegh1tsg6.heard: But you know, I'm sixty-five now. And as a song passes from mouth to mouth, little by little, it changes.

ewo1xnr1tivw.speaker: kromngoy
ewo1xnr1tivw.text: That's why I'm going to the temple today. To have my songs made into a proper book.
ewo1xnr1tivw.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eswchpk186fb.speaker: kromngoy
eswchpk186fb.text: That's right. I'll sing slowly, and the young monks will write them down, word by word, so they tell me.
eswchpk186fb.heard: That's right. I'll sing slowly, and the young monks will write them down, word by word, so they tell me.
eswchpk186fb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ew7u41gt1fmi.speaker: kromngoy
ew7u41gt1fmi.text: Just so. But write them down, and children a hundred years from now can read them just as I sang them.
ew7u41gt1fmi.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1yu8lrr1cw5a.speaker: narr
e1yu8lrr1cw5a.text: You and Borey followed Krom Ngoy north to the temple.
e1yu8lrr1cw5a.heard: You and Borey followed Krom Ngoy north to the temple.
e1yu8lrr1cw5a.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e2d68p64mr5r.heard: A breezy gallery at Wat Ounalom.

ecjwe9n7j8p4.speaker: borey
ecjwe9n7j8p4.text: That's Miss Karpelès. She's a scholar from France. She works at a library that collects sutras and old books.
ecjwe9n7j8p4.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

esx6a3f26fyl.speaker: nekmax
esx6a3f26fyl.text: That's Suzanne Karpelès. That year a Buddhist Institute was founded in Phnom Penh, and she became the person in charge of running its work.
esx6a3f26fyl.heard: That's Suzanne Karpelès. That year a Buddhist Institute was founded in Phnom Penh, and she became the person in charge of running its work.

e1k3msqgkx8ps.speaker: karpeles

e1k3msqgkx8ps.heard: Krom Ngoy, thank you for coming. …And welcome to you too,

ee7gxn91y48d.speaker: karpeles

ee7gxn91y48d.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e38bd5kibzhd.speaker: karpeles
e38bd5kibzhd.text: Krom Ngoy, thank you for coming. …Traveller, have we met somewhere before?
e38bd5kibzhd.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e127f5ky1ubj1.speaker: karpeles
e127f5ky1ubj1.text: Would you sing much more slowly than usual? So that the monks can write down every word.
e127f5ky1ubj1.heard: Would you sing much more slowly than usual? So that the monks can write down every word.
e127f5ky1ubj1.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ezrp8ockdjja.speaker: kromngoy
ezrp8ockdjja.text: Slowly, eh? Sing slowly and folks fall asleep, you know. Ha ha ha.
ezrp8ockdjja.heard: Slowly, eh? Sing slowly and folks fall asleep, you know. Ha ha ha.
ezrp8ockdjja.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e18rphrqk5e0m.speaker: narr
e18rphrqk5e0m.text: Miss Karpelès did not hand the bundle of paper to the monks herself. She called Borey over and gave it to him.
e18rphrqk5e0m.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eszx0i3k7m1t.speaker: borey
eszx0i3k7m1t.text: Women don't hand things straight to monks — that's the rule. So I carry them.
eszx0i3k7m1t.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

exsa2fs1kqu1.speaker: nekmax
exsa2fs1kqu1.text: It's a custom of Theravada Buddhism toward monks. It's said that Karpelès, too, sent her letters and books through someone who stood in between.
exsa2fs1kqu1.heard: It's a custom of Theravada Buddhism toward monks. It's said that Karpelès, too, sent her letters and books through someone who stood in between.
exsa2fs1kqu1.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

efnxbq11fqfw.speaker: narr
efnxbq11fqfw.text: Borey carefully set the bundle of paper down in front of the monks with both hands.
efnxbq11fqfw.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1accsvw1qrhk.speaker: narr
e1accsvw1qrhk.text: Krom Ngoy held the gourd to his chest and began to sing — slowly, very slowly.
e1accsvw1qrhk.heard: Krom Ngoy held the gourd to his chest and began to sing — slowly, very slowly.
e1accsvw1qrhk.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e1fg8wt61voc7.speaker: kromngoy
e1fg8wt61voc7.text: ♪ Learn… your letters… and you'll see… the road…
e1fg8wt61voc7.heard: Learn… your letters… and you'll see…
e1fg8wt61voc7.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eujuyf4p8p7n.speaker: narr

eujuyf4p8p7n.heard: The monks' pens moved with a soft scratching. Word by word, the song lined up on the paper.
eujuyf4p8p7n.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ekekhxs1dhi3.speaker: karpeles
ekekhxs1dhi3.text: This temple holds many sutras written on palm leaves. The monks have copied and protected them for hundreds of years.
ekekhxs1dhi3.heard: This temple holds many sutras written on palm leaves. The monks have copied and protected them for hundreds of years.
ekekhxs1dhi3.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e50zui71ezzn.speaker: karpeles
e50zui71ezzn.text: We help make them into books, and send them to other temples and to anyone who wants to learn.
e50zui71ezzn.heard: We help make them into books, and send them to other temples and to anyone who wants to learn.
e50zui71ezzn.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

e9twkkziw30o.speaker: karpeles
e9twkkziw30o.text: Because songs are words the people of this country have always treasured too. …And because all over the country, people are waiting for Krom Ngoy's songs.
e9twkkziw30o.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eqskvrl13ren.speaker: narr
eqskvrl13ren.text: Only the sound of pens, the singing voice and the wind off the river passed through the gallery.
eqskvrl13ren.heard: Only the sound of pens, the singing voice and the wind off the river passed through the gallery.
eqskvrl13ren.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

eknuuoc4776j.speaker: narr
eknuuoc4776j.text: During a break, you and Borey stepped outside the gallery.
eknuuoc4776j.heard: During a break, you and Borey stepped outside the gallery.
eknuuoc4776j.scene: 苦しさの先に、前を向く場面。静かな力をこめて

ep388ly12914.speaker: borey
ep388ly12914.text: Hey, do you know what a train is? A carriage that puffs out smoke and runs on an iron road. They say they're building an iron road all the way to a faraway town right now.
ep388ly12914.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ei4ci6w1yc8o.speaker: borey
ei4ci6w1yc8o.text: But how do you say “train” in Khmer? Do we just use the French word?
ei4ci6w1yc8o.heard: But how do you say "train" in Khmer? Do we just use the French word?
ei4ci6w1yc8o.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1xsedvmz6x8z.speaker: narr
e1xsedvmz6x8z.text: Just then, a monk in a yellow robe quietly passed by. He was thin, and there was a gentle light deep in his eyes.
e1xsedvmz6x8z.heard: Just then, a monk in a yellow robe quietly passed by. He was thin, and there was a gentle light deep in his eyes.
e1xsedvmz6x8z.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e13iouwh11hs5.speaker: narr

e13iouwh11hs5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1rcpg4x1r8sr.text: It's the Venerable Chuon Nath…! He's a scholar monk who's making the dictionary of the Khmer language.
e1rcpg4x1r8sr.heard: It's the Venerable Chuon Nath…! He's a scholar monk who's making the dictionary of the Khmer language.
e1rcpg4x1r8sr.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e4ypckokjww7.speaker: chuonnath
e4ypckokjww7.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1o6xjqe16yiv.speaker: borey
e1o6xjqe16yiv.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1wd3cl11dvyj.speaker: chuonnath
e1wd3cl11dvyj.text: Welcome, traveller. …Have we met somewhere before?
e1wd3cl11dvyj.heard: Welcome, traveller. …Have we met somewhere before?
e1wd3cl11dvyj.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1yclhig138lb.speaker: borey
e1yclhig138lb.text: V-Venerable Teacher. How should we say “train” in Khmer?
e1yclhig138lb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1txjwfs1txa8.speaker: chuonnath

e1blqas11glpy.heard: Rather than simply borrowing words from other lands, we can also build Khmer words from the roots of Pali and Sanskrit.

ebc5bia1yxmu.speaker: chuonnath
ebc5bia1yxmu.text: For a train, for example — join “metal” and “vehicle.”

e1o8l87tmzbf5.speaker: chuonnath
e1o8l87tmzbf5.text: And the sutras, too. If we print them, we can send them to temples all over the country.
e1o8l87tmzbf5.heard: If we print them, we can send them to temples all over the country.
e1o8l87tmzbf5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ewt9g8nkcwyn.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ekyp6tk14iuf.speaker: nekmax

ekyp6tk14iuf.heard: Chuon Nath was someone who encouraged making names for new things from the roots of Pali and Sanskrit. They say he named the train with a word meaning “a vehicle made of metal.”
ekyp6tk14iuf.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ew3g6x06pw1v.speaker: borey
ew3g6x06pw1v.text: Hey, how do they make new words in your country?
ew3g6x06pw1v.heard: Hey, how do they make new words in your country?
ew3g6x06pw1v.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1d76c3u12y5l.speaker: borey

e1d76c3u12y5l.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ebpxbnn15feh.speaker: borey
ebpxbnn15feh.text: I see. So there are lots of different ways.

ebpxbnn15feh.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1pfxwbi1vrnx.speaker: nekmax
e1pfxwbi1vrnx.text: The English word “telephone” joins the Greek words for “far” and “sound.” The Japanese word for telephone, denwa, was also made by combining kanji, in the Meiji era. All around the world, people have come up with the same kind of idea.
e1pfxwbi1vrnx.heard: The English word "telephone" joins the Greek words for "far" and "sound." The Japanese word for telephone, denwa, was also made by combining kanji, in the Meiji era. All around the world, people have come up with the same kind of idea.
e1pfxwbi1vrnx.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ezh5w7ry8jfk.speaker: narr
ezh5w7ry8jfk.text: From the gallery, the slow singing could be heard again.
ezh5w7ry8jfk.heard: From the gallery, the slow singing could be heard again.
ezh5w7ry8jfk.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eh306e41kwrb.speaker: narr
eh306e41kwrb.text: After a while, Krom Ngoy came out, rubbing his throat.
eh306e41kwrb.heard: After a while, Krom Ngoy came out, rubbing his throat.
eh306e41kwrb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e17zu7o8a7rbk.speaker: kromngoy
e17zu7o8a7rbk.text: Phew, I've sung myself hoarse. …Oh, Borey. There you are.
e17zu7o8a7rbk.heard: Phew, I've sung myself hoarse. …Oh, Borey. There you are.
e17zu7o8a7rbk.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1n4imfp1dt52.speaker: kromngoy
e1n4imfp1dt52.text: Once you've learned your letters, read my songs to someone for me.
e1n4imfp1dt52.heard: Once you've learned your letters, read my songs to someone for me.
e1n4imfp1dt52.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1yt0ha217qcr.speaker: kromngoy
e1yt0ha217qcr.text: A song only comes alive when it's handed on, you see. From my mouth to yours. And from your mouth, on to the next child.
e1yt0ha217qcr.heard: A song only comes alive when it's handed on, you see. From my mouth to yours. And from your mouth, on to the next child.
e1yt0ha217qcr.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1bmw9wl17lzl.speaker: borey
e1bmw9wl17lzl.text: …Okay! I'll read them to my grandma in the village. Her eyes are bad, so I'll be her eyes.
e1bmw9wl17lzl.heard: Okay! I'll read them to my grandma in the village. Her eyes are bad, so I'll be her eyes.
e1bmw9wl17lzl.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

esxsrps12219.speaker: borey
esxsrps12219.text: Heh heh. First I have to learn my letters properly.
esxsrps12219.heard: Heh heh. First I have to learn my letters properly.
esxsrps12219.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ensfqb11gjb5.speaker: borey
ensfqb11gjb5.text: Then do you want to learn your letters with me? I'll lend you my slate!
ensfqb11gjb5.heard: Then do you want to learn your letters with me? I'll lend you my slate!
ensfqb11gjb5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1e011t1g1u3.speaker: nekmax
e1e011t1g1u3.text: (whispering) The bank where Piseth carried the pillar timber is just south of here. Sixty-four years since then. The capital has grown so much.
e1e011t1g1u3.heard: The bank where Piseth carried the pillar timber is just south of here. Sixty-four years since then. The capital has grown so much.
e1e011t1g1u3.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e2fhyuj13t08.speaker: nekmax
e2fhyuj13t08.text: …We're back. This is the riverbank of Phnom Penh today.
e2fhyuj13t08.heard: We're back. This is the riverbank of Phnom Penh today.
e2fhyuj13t08.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

evw6hhpnlknl.speaker: nekmax
evw6hhpnlknl.text: In 1930, the Buddhist Institute was founded in Phnom Penh. It studied sutras and old Khmer literature, printed them as books and sent them to temples all over the country.
evw6hhpnlknl.heard: In 1930, the Buddhist Institute was founded in Phnom Penh. It studied sutras and old Khmer literature, printed them as books and sent them to temples all over the country.
evw6hhpnlknl.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e18wcnfb1d0x8.speaker: nekmax
e18wcnfb1d0x8.text: The ones who copied and protected the palm-leaf manuscripts for hundreds of years were the temples' monks. The Institute helped turn them into books and bring them to many more people.
e18wcnfb1d0x8.heard: The ones who copied and protected the palm-leaf manuscripts for hundreds of years were the temples' monks. The Institute helped turn them into books and bring them to many more people.
e18wcnfb1d0x8.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

esp35welpic4.speaker: nekmax
esp35welpic4.text: Krom Ngoy's songs became books, and people still read them today.
esp35welpic4.heard: Krom Ngoy's songs became books, and people still
esp35welpic4.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

el7c5zh114cj.speaker: nekmax
el7c5zh114cj.text: Masters of the chapei, a long-necked stringed instrument — like Prach Chhuon, who died in 2018 — have kept singing Krom Ngoy's teaching songs on the chapei.
el7c5zh114cj.heard: Masters of the chapei, a long-necked stringed instrument — like Prach Chhuon, who died in 2018 — have kept singing Krom Ngoy's teaching songs on the chapei.
el7c5zh114cj.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

exx3qjp1byin.speaker: nekmax
exx3qjp1byin.text: In 2016, chapei singing was added to UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding, because so few players remain.
exx3qjp1byin.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

ey20l6h12vtx.speaker: nekmax
ey20l6h12vtx.text: The first volume of Chuon Nath's dictionary came out in 1938. It kept being revised, and in 2023 a new edition was even made into a smartphone app.
ey20l6h12vtx.heard: The first volume of Chuon Nath's dictionary came out in 1938. It kept being revised, and in 2023 a new edition was even made into a smartphone app.
ey20l6h12vtx.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e1r1msab1qauj.speaker: nekmax
e1r1msab1qauj.text: Later on, Chuon Nath also wrote the words of Cambodia's national anthem.
e1r1msab1qauj.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e2jzsyeoe3us.speaker: nekmax
e2jzsyeoe3us.text: In 2008, big statues of Chuon Nath and Krom Ngoy were put up in parks in Phnom Penh.
e2jzsyeoe3us.heard: In 2008, big statues of Chuon Nath and Krom Ngoy were put up in parks in Phnom Penh.
e2jzsyeoe3us.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e1gvnhqy1vr6u.speaker: nekmax
e1gvnhqy1vr6u.text: (whispering) Leakhena's dance was handed on to her by Teacher Neary, too, wasn't it?
e1gvnhqy1vr6u.heard: Leakhena's dance was handed on to her by Teacher Neary, too, wasn't it?
e1gvnhqy1vr6u.scene: 今の時代の、明るくおだやかな場面

e1ymeuerrp1d1.speaker: nekmax
e1ymeuerrp1d1.text: Learn the songs by heart, write them down, and hand them on to the next person. …That's how words stay alive.
e1ymeuerrp1d1.heard: Learn the songs by heart, write them down, and hand them on to the next person. …That's how words stay alive.

etfd03w1vgz1.speaker: nekmax
